title: Company plan controls alongside the credit model
question: How do project intent control, the 5X flag and the prepaid / pay-as-you-go contract type relate to the credit model? What does each contract type allow? Should project intent control be on or off when its setting is missing?
context: Project intent control is on track-3d-dev as an "interim" setup (BILL-REQ-023), and its default is disputed (BILL-REQ-024). The contract type and 5X fields exist but nothing reads them (BILL-REQ-025). The credit model is on separate feature branches and does not use any of these.
